changelog: Library Stats: coherent percent model — exclusive dims use title count; genres/tags/studios use assignment share; people use role-credit share. Top 20 + mandatory Other sum to ~100%. Fixed UI truncating Other; chart hints for multi-label/people denominators.
description: Fetches complete TMDB cast and crew for movies and series, groups people by department, and shows them in a polished accordion on Jellyfin Web item detail pages. Includes a nostalgia Break Bumper action and a Library Stats page.
name: Full Crew
overview: Full cast and crew by department, break bumpers, and library stats
